findings: Workflow input interpolated directly into a shell command requires injection review; the example is not an accepted safe template.
pull_request_target bypasses public-fork workflow approval; approval does not establish infrastructure isolation.
Third-party action terms and immutable SHA recommendations remain distinct from adopted policy and rights clearance.
scope: Twenty full pinned source fragments reviewed. No raster certification, installation, workflow execution, credentials, native mutation, rights approval or policy adoption. Independent audit and published-page assurance remain separate.
